label: Bible Study
prompt: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy _____ shall be established for ever.
verse: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
note: God's covenant with David — a house, a kingdom, and a throne established for ever.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well _____ to overcome it.
verse: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
note: Ten spies saw giants; Caleb saw a land they were well able to take.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the _____ of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
verse: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
note: While the sailors prayed and tossed cargo overboard, Jonah was fast asleep down in the sides of the ship.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Dead _____ cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
verse: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
note: A few dead flies can spoil a whole jar of perfume — and a little folly, a big reputation.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath _____ upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verse: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
note: 'Behold, what manner of love' — John pauses mid-letter to marvel that we're called the sons of God.
